1 import SixVertexUnfolding.PrismDiagonalSelection
2 
3 /-! Larger explicit curvature regions in which a maximum slit is an original edge. -/
4 
5 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph
6 
7 open OctahedralTriangles
8 
9 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (graph : P.SixVertexGraph)
10 variable (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
11   (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
12 
13 include small_faces in
14 /-- Source 0 works whenever it is the sharper pole and vertex 2 is not the unique equator maximum. -/
15 theorem hasEdgeUnfolding_of_prismDiagonal_first_region (kind : graph.kind = .prismDiagonal)
16     (source_order : graph.curvature 1 ≤ graph.curvature 0)
17     (slit_order : graph.curvature 2 ≤ max (graph.curvature 3) (max (graph.curvature 4) (graph.curvature 5))) :
18     P.HasEdgeUnfolding := by
19   have alternative : ∃ other : Fin 4, other ≠ 0 ∧
20       graph.curvature (fanNeighbor 0 0) ≤ graph.curvature (fanNeighbor 0 other) := by
21     rcases le_max_iff.mp slit_order with h | h
22     · exact ⟨2, by decide, h⟩
23     rcases le_max_iff.mp h with h | h
24     · exact ⟨1, by decide, h⟩
25     · exact ⟨3, by decide, h⟩
26   obtain ⟨other, different, comparison⟩ := alternative
27   obtain ⟨slit, avoids, maximal⟩ := equator_maximum_avoiding
28     (fun i => graph.curvature (fanNeighbor 0 i)) 0 other different comparison
29   apply graph.hasEdgeUnfolding_of_original_cut_selection small_faces 0 slit source_order maximal
30   · intro j
31     apply (graph.edges _ _).mpr
32     rw [kind]
33     exact (by decide : ∀ j, SmallGraphs.SixGraphKind.prismDiagonal.adjacent 0 (fanNeighbor 0 j)) j
34   · apply (graph.edges _ _).mpr
35     rw [kind]
36     exact (by decide : ∀ slit : Fin 4, slit ≠ 0 →
37       SmallGraphs.SixGraphKind.prismDiagonal.adjacent (opposite 0) (fanNeighbor 0 slit)) slit avoids
38 
39 include small_faces in
40 /-- Source 5 gives the reflected region, with all equality cases included. -/
41 theorem hasEdgeUnfolding_of_prismDiagonal_last_region (kind : graph.kind = .prismDiagonal)
42     (source_order : graph.curvature 4 ≤ graph.curvature 5)
43     (slit_order : graph.curvature 3 ≤ max (graph.curvature 0) (max (graph.curvature 1) (graph.curvature 2))) :
44     P.HasEdgeUnfolding := by
45   have alternative : ∃ other : Fin 4, other ≠ 3 ∧
46       graph.curvature (fanNeighbor 5 3) ≤ graph.curvature (fanNeighbor 5 other) := by
47     rcases le_max_iff.mp slit_order with h | h
48     · exact ⟨0, by decide, h⟩
49     rcases le_max_iff.mp h with h | h
50     · exact ⟨2, by decide, h⟩
51     · exact ⟨1, by decide, h⟩
52   obtain ⟨other, different, comparison⟩ := alternative
53   obtain ⟨slit, avoids, maximal⟩ := equator_maximum_avoiding
54     (fun i => graph.curvature (fanNeighbor 5 i)) 3 other different comparison
55   apply graph.hasEdgeUnfolding_of_original_cut_selection small_faces 5 slit source_order maximal
56   · intro j
57     apply (graph.edges _ _).mpr
58     rw [kind]
59     exact (by decide : ∀ j, SmallGraphs.SixGraphKind.prismDiagonal.adjacent 5 (fanNeighbor 5 j)) j
60   · apply (graph.edges _ _).mpr
61     rw [kind]
62     exact (by decide : ∀ slit : Fin 4, slit ≠ 3 →
63       SmallGraphs.SixGraphKind.prismDiagonal.adjacent (opposite 5) (fanNeighbor 5 slit)) slit avoids
64 
65 include small_faces in
66 /-- Outside the completed regions, each eligible source has one strictly forbidden maximum. -/
67 theorem prismDiagonal_unfolding_or_strict_obstructions (kind : graph.kind = .prismDiagonal) :
68     P.HasEdgeUnfolding ∨
69       ((graph.curvature 0 < graph.curvature 1 ∨
70         max (graph.curvature 3) (max (graph.curvature 4) (graph.curvature 5)) < graph.curvature 2) ∧
71        (graph.curvature 5 < graph.curvature 4 ∨
72         max (graph.curvature 0) (max (graph.curvature 1) (graph.curvature 2)) < graph.curvature 3)) := by
73   by_cases first : graph.curvature 1 ≤ graph.curvature 0 ∧
74       graph.curvature 2 ≤ max (graph.curvature 3) (max (graph.curvature 4) (graph.curvature 5))
75   · exact Or.inl (graph.hasEdgeUnfolding_of_prismDiagonal_first_region small_faces kind first.1 first.2)
76   by_cases last : graph.curvature 4 ≤ graph.curvature 5 ∧
77       graph.curvature 3 ≤ max (graph.curvature 0) (max (graph.curvature 1) (graph.curvature 2))
78   · exact Or.inl (graph.hasEdgeUnfolding_of_prismDiagonal_last_region small_faces kind last.1 last.2)
79   push Not at first last
80   refine Or.inr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
81   · by_cases h : graph.curvature 1 ≤ graph.curvature 0
82     · exact Or.inr (first h)
83     · exact Or.inl (lt_of_not_ge h)
84   · by_cases h : graph.curvature 4 ≤ graph.curvature 5
85     · exact Or.inr (last h)
86     · exact Or.inl (lt_of_not_ge h)
87 
88 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph
